mapper.select: SELECT menu_id,menu_name FROM the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND del_yn='N'
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM the_full_order.tb_menu_master WHERE menu_id=#{menu_id}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master WHERE menu_id=#{menu_id})
SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND menu_id=#{menu_id}

SELECT r.*,i.ingredient_id standard_ingredient_id, COALESCE(ai.ingredient_name_std,ai.ingredient_name_raw,r.ingredient_name_raw,r.ingredient_id) ingredient_name FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail r LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master i ON i.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master ai ON ai.account_id=r.account_id AND ai.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id WHERE r.account_id=#{account_id} AND r.menu_id=#{menu_id} ORDER BY r.ingredient_seq,r.account_recipe_detail_id
SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_recipe_detail WHERE menu_id=#{menu_id} ORDER BY ingredient_seq,recipe_detail_id
SELECT menu_id,menu_name FROM the_full_order.tb_menu_master WHERE del_yn='N'

SELECT a.ingredient_id,COALESCE(a.ingredient_name_std,a.ingredient_name_raw,i.ingredient_name_std,i.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name, a.category_name,a.base_unit,a.storage_type,CASE WHEN i.ingredient_id IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END standard_yn FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master a LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master i ON i.ingredient_id=a.ingredient_id WHERE a.account_id=#{account_id} AND a.active_yn='Y' ORDER BY ingredient_name

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master WHERE ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master WHERE ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id})
